subject: Residency implementation worksheet & private-link ops for EU-only deployment - StellarCare
messages:
From: Emma Hudson <emma.hudson@stellarcare.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T09:13:00Z
Subject: Residency implementation details & evidence request (EU-only)

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. StellarCare is moving forward with a pilot and our security team needs a compact evidence package showing how Redwood will host our workloads strictly within the EU for the pilot. Specific asks: 

- A one-page runbook for how a Private deployment is instantiated for an EU-only tenant (VPC peering / Privatelink steps).
- Network diagram showing private endpoints, peering/VPN, and egress controls.
- Evidence of KMS key partitioning / whether keys for EU deployments are kept in region-specific KMS or multi-region.
- SIG/CAIQ mapping for the controls that demonstrate territorial isolation, plus pointers to any SOC 2 sections that cover data locality.

Can you send an initial worksheet today? If helpful we can loop in our external auditor (Vinod Patel) — he can accept Drive links but requests little attachments as a single zip.

Best,
Emma
Emma Hudson
Head of Security Operations, StellarCare
security@stellarcare.com
(attachment: stellarcare_requirements_v1.xlsx)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emma Hudson <emma.hudson@stellarcare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T15:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Residency implementation details & evidence request (EU-only)

Thanks, Emma — we can absolutely provide that. High-level plan and next steps below, and I pasted Marcus and Neha for the ops / crypto details.

Proposed deliverables (I can send a first-pass PDF + Drive packet today):
- "Residency playbook" (1–2 pages): step-by-step Private deployment runbook for EU-only tenants.
- Network diagram (SVG + PNG): Privatelink endpoints, peering, subnets, egress DNAT / NAT gateway patterns.
- KMS partitioning note: clarifies our EU-only keys (customer-managed KMS option + Redwood-managed regional KMS behavior).
- SIG/CAIQ mapping sheet: rows called out for geographic controls (CAIQ/CCM + SOC2 references).

Quick notes:
- For the pilot we recommend Private deployment (VPC peering + Privatelink) with customer-managed KMS in their EU key ring (recommended) — that ensures crypto material never leaves region.
- Default Redwood-managed KMS for EU model endpoints is regional (separate key ARNs) but if you need HSM-backed keys we can capture that in the runbook.

Would a short 30 min call tomorrow morning (EU timezone 10:00–11:00 CET) work to walk the auditors through the packet?

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Principal, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
(attachment: residency_playbook_draft_notes.txt)

> Thanks, Emma — we can absolutely provide that. High-level plan and next steps below...

Thanks — call works for us. Can you make sure the packet explicitly states:

- Whether packet capture / network flow logs (VPC Flow Logs) can be retained and exported to our EU logging account.
- Whether any control plane metadata (billing, monitoring) leaves EU for processing (we need a clear statement).
- Timeline for providing a signed SIG/CAIQ matrix (redwood sign-off) and the SOC 2 section references.

Vinod — looping you in to confirm preferred format. We prefer a Drive folder + single zip for upload to our portal.

Emma

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emma Hudson <emma.hudson@stellarcare.com>, Vinod Patel <v.patel@techaudit.co>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-24T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Residency implementation details & evidence request (EU-only)

Emma / Vinod — attached is the initial evidence packet. Below is a concise mapping and summary so your security team can triage quickly.

Attachments included (zipped):
- residency_playbook_v1.pdf (1–2 page runbook: creation steps, required customer actions, and rollback)
- network_diagram_eu_privatelink.svg (Privatelink + peering + NAT/Egress zones)
- sig_caiq_mapping_v2.xlsx (mapping sheet with CAIQ questions, control IDs, and SOC2 section refs)

Quick summary answers:
- VPC Flow Logs: yes — can be enabled per-private deployment and exported to a customer-owned EU logging bucket (we include operational steps in the playbook).
- Control plane metadata: control-plane telemetry for management (e.g., job scheduling, autoscaling events) is processed in our control plane region; for EU private deployments the control plane does not store customer content. We provide an explicit appendix in the playbook that lists telemetry types and retention windows.
- KMS / keys: by default Redwood-managed KMS uses a regional key per EU cluster (keys do not replicate out-of-region). We strongly recommend customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key) for pilot; instructions and example IAM bindings are in the playbook.
- SOC 2 references: SOC 2 report sections referenced in the mapping sheet (available under NDA) — we can provide SOC 2 redacted report or an auditor-to-auditor channel for Vinod.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm format preference (Drive link + zip works).
2) If you want the signed SIG/CAIQ matrix we will produce a signed PDF within 48h after your confirmation.
3) If Vinod wants a short calls to validate items, Marcus can run the networking / peering portion and Neha will cover crypto / KMS.

Thanks — sending Drive link now: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-residency-pack (access: anyone-with-link, expires in 30 days).

Priya Natarajan
Principal, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
(attachments: residency_playbook_v1.pdf, network_diagram_eu_privatelink.svg, sig_caiq_mapping_v2.xlsx)
